scope: Only public/F4M/lab/ added. No original game, preview, presentation or chess files modified.

tests.browser_context: Exact modular sources assembled inline for offline Chromium set_content and real Blob Workers. Native-origin navigation blocked by browser administrator. Persistence roundtrip tested with explicit memory Storage adapter, not native domain.
tests.match_budget: 4000 action-simulation work units; max depth 3; paired color swap; both policies measured from same report
tests.strength_claim: None. Engineering validation only; six games are not strength evidence.

architecture.dcc: Physics and completed-depth path sensors; bounded 12-point selector; not full recursive rDCC
architecture.budget: Shared candidate analysis includes all physical sensor probes. Each action simulation costs one work unit. Fixed-work mode has no wall deadline. Selector overhead is separately measured.
architecture.time: Clock display and timestamps default hidden; human game supports countdown+increment. Sim has no game-clock limit. Pauses and animations excluded.
architecture.resume: Per-ply isolated localStorage checkpoint; explicit JSON export. Storage quota failure is visible, not silently durable. Fixed-work runs reproducible; time-bounded runs are hardware/timing dependent.

verification_limits: Direct public HTTP from container fails DNS.
Live browser navigation and localhost navigation blocked by administrator.
Native-origin localStorage not tested; explicit memory adapter used.
Netlify publication is verified separately using commit/deploy metadata.
